His primary diagnosis is acute brachyuticitis (a throat infection) on the 20th day, with secondary conditions including early pneumonia and hyperthyroidism with ICP of 19°C. He’s currently being IV’d with hyperparasomal atonic polyatomic (PAP) medication. He has a doctor nearby, Dr. Maria Tanzi, MD, and is being closely monitored to ensure optimal care.

Emily reports feeling tired all week, joint pain, and morning stiffness.
